title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
subtitle: Clear guidelines on how we handle transaction errors, market voids, and withdrawal cancellations.
intro: Cricbet99 is committed to a fair and transparent financial experience. We understand that transaction errors or market changes can happen, and this policy outlines exactly how we resolve such cases for our members.
Every refund or cancellation request is reviewed manually by our dedicated finance team on WhatsApp to ensure precision and human accountability. We do not use automated bots to handle your money.
Our goal is to ensure that you are never left in the dark regarding your balance. We follow regulated Indian banking protocols for all financial adjustments.

features.title: Transaction Error Protection
features.desc: If a deposit fails to reflect in your ID balance, we initiate a manual verification and refund process within 2 hours.

features.title: Market Void Guarantee
features.desc: In cases of match abandonment or technical errors, your stake is returned to your balance instantly.

features.title: Zero Deduction Refunds
features.desc: We do not charge any administrative fees for processing legitimate refunds or transaction corrections.

features.title: Transparent Cancellation
features.desc: You can cancel a pending withdrawal request anytime before it is processed by contacting your account manager.

features.title: Settlement Audit Trail
features.desc: Every financial adjustment is logged and can be audited by the player upon request through support channels.

features.title: KYC-Verified Payouts
features.desc: Refunds and payouts are only sent to verified bank accounts to prevent fraud and ensure you receive your funds.

faqs.q: How long does a refund take?
faqs.a: Most transaction corrections are resolved within 2-4 hours, while bank-level reversals may take 2-3 working days depending on your provider.

faqs.q: What if a match is called off?
faqs.a: If a match is abandoned without a result (e.g., due to rain), all pending bets are voided and stakes are returned 100%.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for losses?
faqs.a: No. Refunds are only applicable to transaction errors or voided markets. Settled bets resulting in a loss are not refundable.

faqs.q: How do I request a refund?
faqs.a: Simply send your transaction ID and a screenshot of the error to our official WhatsApp support number.

ctaSub: Our human-led support team is online 24/7 to resolve any deposit, withdrawal, or refund query you have.
